origin: telluric band (Fraunhofer); solar Fe I (Rowland line)
note: Caveat: Fraunhofer's a is the telluric H2O band, and the solar values for this Fe I line are H2O-blended and disagree. MMH 7164.432 (disc centre) and the IAG core fit (-386 m/s) lie blueward of NIST Fe I 7164.4481, while the APGL98 flux value 7164.4578 is +406 m/s above it (+385 m/s above the Nave et al. 1994 value 7164.4486 used in APGL98b). Not a clean single-line reference. Fraunhofer (1817): "At a there are heaped together many lines which form a band" between A and B = telluric H2O bands (MMH 1966: H2O 400/301/202/221/103 bands, 6845-7480 A). Rowland/Smithsonian list a = 7164.725 (no element); MMH 1966 identifies the line at 7164.432 as solar Fe I (EW 153 mA). Strong telluric H2O lines lie within 0.1 A (HITRAN 7164.348, 7164.403 A air), so the solar position is blend-affected. Wikipedia/German WP "a = O2 627.661 nm" is the Greek-alpha O2 gamma-band group (Rowland alpha), a different feature.
